subject: Request: Executive sign-off for >20% Hosted API discount for ISCape pilot
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Executive sign-off for >20% Hosted API discount for ISCape pilot

Hi Ben / Karthik —

Following the demo this week, ISCape (B2B SaaS: document ingestion + retrieval) is pushing to move from a 6-week trial to a 6-month paid pilot. They want predictable unit pricing, and have requested a 25% off list Hosted API rate for the pilot (estimated committed spend ~$120k over 6 months).

Why this matters: ISCape is backed by VentureCap (Elena copied in) and has an active pipeline of enterprise prospects where our integration with their product would be strategically visible. The pilot is low friction to onboard and they’re willing to 6-month commit + LOI if we can lock pricing and a short exclusivity for the integration windows.

Attached: usage projections, proposed master terms v3, pilot SOW.

Ask: Exec approval for a 25% discount on Hosted API (usage) for a 6-month pilot, conditioned on:
- Minimum committed spend of $100k over 6 months (pay-as-you-go credits + monthly true-ups)
- Pilot KPIs: latency < 300ms p50, monthly active users > 10k by month 4, and token quality/regression checks (we’ll tie Redwood Optimize evals)
- Legal to sign the attached term sheet with a 90-day opt-out after pilot if KPIs unmet

If we only get 15%–20% we risk the deal (ISCape cited direct competitor pricing). I’m escalating because this is >20% and outside Deal Desk delegated limits.

Timeline: ISCape needs a definitive answer by EOD Tuesday (9/1) to meet their board cadence.

Proposed fallback: Offer 20% + a one-time onboarding credit of $10k, plus a performance-based rebate (if KPIs met, additional credit applied).

Thoughts? I recommend approval for 25% for the 6-month pilot — high strategic upside + referral potential.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: ISCape_MAAP_usage_projections.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposed_master_terms_v3.pdf (pdf), pilot-sow-iscape.docx (docx)

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sign-off for >20% Hosted API discount for ISCape pilot

+1 on Soojin’s summary. Quick clarifying points for exec review:
- Forecasted committed spend is $120k gross; net recognized likely ~$105k after credits/overage smoothing. See attached projections.
- ISCape will be integrating across both our embeddings and text-generation endpoints; their token profile is heavy on embeddings (~65%). That lowers per-token cost exposure but increases request volume.
- Risk: If we offer 25% and the pilot fails early, reclaiming credits is difficult politically (customer experience / PR).

I’ve looped in Mina for revenue impact and Karthik for legal redlines.

Requested from Marissa: Exec sign-off to allow Deal Desk to approve the 25% discount with the conditionals Soojin outlined. If you prefer the fallback, we can pivot quickly.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Marissa / team —

I ran the numbers on the attached projections and the proposed terms. Key points:
- At 25% discount, estimated recognized revenue over the 6-month pilot (assuming projected usage) = ~$85k; gross margin impact ~ -11 percentage points vs baseline pricing.
- If we structure as a committed credit that ISCape pays up-front, upside is limited but downside protected. If we do pay-as-you-go credits, we need a clawback or KPI-triggered rebate structure (legal to bake language).
- Recommended guardrails: 1) Minimum commitment $100k, 2) Performance milestone tied credits (25% unlocked after KPIs met), 3) Cap total discount to the pilot term only (reverts to list afterward).

I can support 20% approval at Deal Desk level today. For anything >20% (i.e., 25%), I need Marissa or an exec to approve given margin exposure. Also request we A/B the concession across regions (pilot US-only).

Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: updated_projection_impact.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sign-off for >20% Hosted API discount for ISCape pilot

Team —

I’ve reviewed Soojin’s ask and Mina’s impact analysis. Given the strategic signals (VentureCap backing + clear enterprise pipeline) and the relatively short pilot window, I am prepared to approve a one-time 25% hosted-API discount for the 6-month pilot under the following binding conditions:

1) Contractual: Minimum committed spend of $100k (explicit in SOW). We convert any unused committed credits into platform service credits that expire at pilot end.
2) Performance gating: 50% of the discount (i.e., 12.5% of list) is conditional — it only applies if ISCape meets the agreed KPIs by month 4. If KPI thresholds are not met, the conditional portion is forfeited and we invoice at the higher tier retroactively.
3) Geography: Pilot approval is US-only. Any expansion to EU/APAC requires separate approval.
4) Legal: Karthik/legal to finalize terms and ensure indemnities & data residency language are acceptable. No non-standard SLAs to be introduced.
5) PR/refs: ISCape will provide a short customer case study and be listed as an integration partner in our directory if pilot completes successfully.

Marissa signs off on the above for this specific pilot and duration. Please have Legal and Soojin circulate the final MTA and pilot SOW with the gating language. Confirm once DocuSign link created so I can countersign.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
